items.source: Creates a new context for an operation being invoked by the given securityContext with the given available arguments.
items.translation: 为给定 securityContext` 调用的操作以及给定的可用 arguments` 创建一个新的上下文。

items.source: Resolves an argument with the given argumentType.

Returns whether the context is capable of resolving an argument of the given type. Note that, even when true is returned, argument resolution will return null if no argument of the required type is available.
items.translation: 返回上下文是否具备解析给定type参数的能力。请注意，即使返回true，如果不可用所需类型的参数，参数解析仍将返回null。
securityContext - 当前的安全上下文。永远不为 null。

items.source: arguments - the arguments available to the operation. Never null
items.translation: arguments - 操作可用的参数。永远不为 null

items.source: true if resolution of arguments of the given type is possible, otherwise false.
items.translation: true 如果可能解析给定类型的参数，否则为 false。

items.source: argumentResolvers - resolvers for additional arguments should be available to the operation.
items.translation: argumentResolvers - 用于解析额外参数的解析器应可供操作使用。

items.source: resolved argument of the required type or null
items.translation: 解析了所需类型的参数或null。

items.source: The context for the invocation of an operation.
items.translation: 操作调用的上下文，invocation of an operation。

items.source: Returns whether the context is capable of resolving an argument of the given type.
items.translation: 返回上下文是否能够解析给定 type 的参数。
